title: Figure Theme Bible
description: Shared theme specification used by transparent-icons and ai-full-figure to keep visual style consistent across a generated set. Attach the theme to each generation call so prompts derive from a single source of truth.

theme_id.description: Short identifier for the theme; used to label generated artifacts.

palette.description: Hex color codes referenced by the prompt. Recommended: primary, accent, neutral, bg. Accepts 3-, 4-, 6-, or 8-digit CSS hex codes or the literal 'transparent'.

stroke.description: Line treatment for icons and overlays.

style_tokens.description: Positive prompt fragments (e.g., 'flat 2D', 'single continuous line', 'no shading').

composition.description: Layout conventions for the generated images.

reference_images.description: Up to 16 file paths of canonical reference images attached to each generation for style transfer (gpt-image-2 multi-reference feature).

model_preferences.description: Per-use-case model selection. Values are advisory hints consumed by the generator scripts.

bg_removal.description: Post-process transparency method. Omit --transparent on generate_icon.py if the substrate should remain opaque (e.g. ai-full-figure substrates).
